224-2157-5954-8345.notablePrerequisites: Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
224-2157-5954-8345.description:
Cast Overlord of the Hauntwoods by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Warp Speed.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 3.

151-5261-7280.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-5261-7280.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-5261-7280.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Donatello.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

3263-6798-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-6798-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.
3263-6798-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

628-2018-7071.description:
Activate Ticking Gnomes by sacrificing it.
When Ticking Gnomes dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Ticking Gnomes from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ticking Gnomes ability
Activate Ticking Gnomes by sacrificing it.
When Ticking Gnomes dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Ticking Gnomes from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Ticking Gnomes ability
Repeat

575-1794-4247.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-4716.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1170-5131-5315-7052--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5315-7052--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Savvy Trader.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the artifact, giving Ravenous Intruder +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and without summoning sickness

4613-4899-5955.description:
Activate Giggling Skitterspike using Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Giggling Skitterspike equal to the card's mana value.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Declare Giggling Skitterspike as an attacker, triggering its ability, dealing damage equal to its power to each opponent.

1987-3821-7874.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3821-7874.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}.
The Immortal Weapons' second ability triggers, giving a creature +2/+0 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking The Immortal Weapons and Peregrine Drake.
When The Immortal Weapons and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the The Immortal Weapons trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-3821-7874.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

4644-5833-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more creatures.
4644-5833-7791.description:
Activate Leafkin Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Leafkin Druid.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Leafkin Druid.
Repeat.

3259-7175-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4017-5086-5183-5231-6441.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4017-5086-5183-5231-6441.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with The Third Doctor

1409-5422-6441.description:
Activate The Third Doctor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When The Third Doctor enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and The Third Doctor.
Resolve the The Third Doctor trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2893-3470-5455-5478.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the basic land enters, Lotus Cobra and Bristly Bill trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bristly Bill trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4846-5295-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-5295-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

38-659-7060.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-7060.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

1283-1978-3488.description:
Animate Chromatic Orrery using Katsumasa.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.

589-1786-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-1786-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2059-4679-6023.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Village Bell-Ringer token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-3000-4593-5870.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and get {E}{E}
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-3000-4593-5870.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2558-3490-5231-5330-6701.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Repeat.
2558-3490-5231-5330-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

488-641-1482-3200-4986.notablePrerequisites: One of either Jeweled Lotus or Urza's Bauble must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-641-1482-3200-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Kroxa from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kroxa enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Kroxa trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Kroxa trigger, causing each opponent to discard a card and lose 3 life if they didn't discard a nonland card.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

560-1940-2511-4550.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-1940-2511-4550.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Repeat.

3129-4871-6074.description:
During your upkeep, activate Nim Devourer by paying {B}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield, and then sacrificing it.
When Nim Devourer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2743-5669.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands that share a nonbasic land type.
2743-5669.description:
Cast March from Velis Vel by paying {2}{U}, causing at least three lands you control to become a copy of Biovisionary until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, each Bioviosionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

4809-4934-5220.description:
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shifting Wall on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Shifting Wall from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2043-3499-4131-4365.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Basalt Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate both Basalt Monolith tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

841-2292-3585-4544.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-2292-3585-4544.description:
Play a land card, triggering Dúnedain Rangers and Greensleeves.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the Badger token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Badger, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dúnedain Rangers and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
NOTE: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

3718-5195.notablePrerequisites: You control an indestructible non-creature permanent.
3718-5195.description:
Cast Chain of Acid by paying {3}{G}, targeting any indestructible non-creature permanent you control.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, causing you to create a Treasure token.
Resolve Chain of Acid, failing to destroy the indestructible permanent and choosing to copy Chain of Acid, targeting the indestructible permanent with the copy.
Repeat from step 2.

406-1525-3681-4298.notablePrerequisites:
Grafted Exoskeleton and Tandem Lookout is paired with Borborygmos.
You have a land card in hand.
You have at least eleven lands between your hand and library.
406-1525-3681-4298.description:
Activate Borborygmos by discarding a land, dealing three infect damage to an opponent.
Borborygmos triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, put it into your hand and put all other cards revealed this way on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
